Title: Diagnosis
Details:
The failure of the test `testToClass_object()` is caused by a NullPointerException (NPE) when the method `ClassUtils.toClass(Object[])` is called with an array containing a null element. According to the test, the input array to `toClass` includes a null element: `new Object[] { "Test", null, 99d }`. The test expects the output array of Classes to be `{ String.class, null, Double.class }`.

The implementation of `ClassUtils.toClass(Object[] array)` shows that it iterates over the input array and calls `getClass()` on each element without checking if the element is null. This directly leads to a NullPointerException when encountering a null element, since calling `getClass()` on null is invalid.

Hence, the root cause is that `toClass` does not handle null entries in the input array gracefully, contrary to the test's expectations of returning `null` for null elements instead of throwing an exception.

No related recent bug reports are relevant to this issue.

The fix involves adding a null check inside the loop in `toClass(Object[])` and setting the corresponding output element to null if the input element is null. This would satisfy the test's expected behavior and prevent the NPE.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
